subject: Sponsorship SOW + media rights — Midtown Tech Summit (custom requests)
messages:
From: Lucy Chen <lucy@midtownsummit.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: oliver@eventops.co
Date: 2027-05-10T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Midtown Tech Summit — sponsorship follow-up and custom SOW

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — Midtown would love to get Redwood on the main stage and in our demo zone. Attached is the standard Platinum packet. A few items we heard you wanted clarified:
- Keynote / speaking option (20–30 min) vs. product demo slot (40 min)
- Logo placement on main stage backdrop + app homepage
- Video recording & repurpose rights for partner content (policy and duration)

Can you confirm technical deliverables (AV run of show), logo file format, and whether Redwood needs exclusive demo hours? If you can share a redline of the SOW by EOD Thursday we can route to legal.

Best,
Lucy Chen
Head of Partnerships — Midtown Tech Summit
Attachments: Midtown_Platinum_Packet.pdf (packet/ PDF)
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Lucy Chen <lucy@midtownsummit.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Midtown Tech Summit — sponsorship follow-up and custom SOW

Hi Lucy — thanks for the packet. I looped in Kim (events ops) and Marcus (growth) to confirm SOW asks. Quick answers up front:
- We can commit to a 20-minute stage slot + 40-minute product demo in the demo zone, rather than a keynote, if Midtown can guarantee the demo pod is within 30m of the main stage and listed as a Featured Demo on the app.
- Logo: we require mainstage backdrop prominent placement (top row, 2nd tier) and app homepage hero slot for the week. Final placement to be agreed in artwork proof.
- Media rights: Redwood is comfortable with event recordings being used by Midtown for up to 12 months across owned channels; any paid redistribution by third parties requires written approval. We would like a clause allowing limited repurpose across Redwood-owned channels (marketing, sales enablement) for 12 months.

Kim — can you review the AV/run-of-show minimums (mic types, laptop feed, capture feed) and confirm whether we need dedicated tech support? Marcus — confirm whether we want exclusivity for the demo pod hours or are fine sharing windows.

I will prepare a redline of the SOW and send back by Friday.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Bring predictable inference to production
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, Lucy Chen <lucy@midtownsummit.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-12T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Midtown Tech Summit — sponsorship follow-up and custom SOW

Hi all — reviewed the packet and sketched required ops redlines. Main points:
1) AV/run-of-show: we require 1 x SDI feed from demo station to main stage capture (for the 40-minute demo); 1 x tech-run (onsite) for 30 minutes before demo; in-booth power (2x 20A circuits) and dedicated wired ethernet (1Gb).
2) Logo placement: request size specs in px for both backdrop file and app hero; will approve once we see proof. We also want the sponsor badge to include "Redwood — Demo Pod Sponsor" wording.
3) Media rights: Kimberly suggests the recording-rights clause read: "Event organizer grants Redwood a non-exclusive license to use event recordings that include Redwood content for commercial marketing, sales enablement, and social platforms for a period of 12 months from event date. Any third-party sale/licensing requires sponsor written consent."

Attached is a draft SOW with these redlines.

Attachments: Redwood_Sponsor_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (doc/ PDF)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Events Program Manager
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-13T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Midtown Tech Summit — sponsorship follow-up and custom SOW

Sofia / Kim — a couple commercial trade thoughts before we send the redline:
- If Midtown will not move us to a true keynote, I recommend offering a 15% revenue credit in exchange for the expanded logo placements (stage + app hero) and a 12-month recording repurpose license. This preserves our exposure while keeping cost reasonable.
- Push for 6 full-conference VIP passes instead of 4 (makes it easier for SE + AE travel coverage).
- Ask for a 30-minute pre-conference briefing with AV tech to avoid day-of issues.

If you want me to propose the commercial concession in the outgoing email, I can phrase it as "in exchange for expanded visibility and recording rights, Redwood will accept a 15% sponsorship credit off the standard Platinum rate."

-Marcus
VP, Growth (cc: deals)
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Lucy Chen <lucy@midtownsummit.com>, Oliver Barnes <oliver@eventops.co>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Midtown Tech Summit — sponsorship follow-up and custom SOW

Lucy / Oliver — appreciate the packet and your flexibility. Please see our consolidated redline below and next steps. We can move forward on the following items:

Accepted / confirmed:
- Demo pod: 40-minute featured demo in the Demo Zone, within 30m of the main stage; dedicated wired 1Gb + 2x 20A circuits + 30-minute tech support pre-demo.
- Speaking: 20-minute featured stage slot (not keynote) and option for a 30–40 minute extended product demo in the Demo Zone on Day 1.
- Logo placement: Main stage backdrop (Top row, 2nd position) + App homepage hero slot for event week; we will provide vector artwork upon signature.
- Media rights: Redwood granted non-exclusive license to use event recordings that include Redwood content for commercial marketing, sales enablement, and social platforms for 12 months. Any paid redistribution by a third party requires Redwood's written approval.
- Passes: 6 VIP full-conference passes.

Commercial concession: In exchange for expanded visibility and the 12-month recording license, Redwood requests a 15% credit off the standard Platinum sponsorship fee. Deal referenced: RDW-2027-154.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the redlines.
2) Midtown to send a revised SOW/contract reflecting the above.
3) We will route the contract to legal; once approved, we will complete signing via DocuSign (link preferred).

Attachments and assets we will send after signature: redwood_logo_svg.zip (logo package), final speaker bio + slides template.

DocuSign draft preferred: https://docusign.com/envelope/AB1234MIDTOWN
Drive SOW link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/MT-2027-Sponsor-SOW

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
